thought.text: All routes work. Let me also verify the static export in `out/` is actually servable, and check page content:

reasoning_content:
All routes are returning 200 with the correct titles, and nonexistent routes return 404. Let's also verify that the static export in out/ is deployable — we can serve it with a simple static server and check. That would be additional validation. The guide says "Statischer Export nach out/ (static export to out/)", so the build is the deliverable. Let's do a quick check: serve out/ with python's http.server and curl the index. Also, verify that the contents of index.html contain the expected portal content.

After that, clean up: stop the dev server (kill the specific PID) and also stop the static server.

Let's do the static export check and the content verification in parallel.

action.command: cd /workspace/out && nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 > /tmp/static.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; for p in / /ea-repository /technologie-radar; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:8080$p"); echo "$code  out$p"; done; curl -s http://localhost:8080/ | grep -oP '(?<=<title>)[^<]+'; curl -s http://localhost:8080/index.html | grep -ciE 'architecture|portal'
